recent_failures.title: Delete ditolak jika Colli Type sudah dipakai Colli code dari New Colli inbound
recent_failures.log_summary:
FAIL copy — delete memang ditolak dan type tetap di datalist, tapi pesan bukan sentence Colli Type.
Delete PLT (dipakai COL-6A7EA8FB / IN-5U4F3GSR) → modal "Are you sure?" → Delete.
Toast: "This data already have relations". Type masih tampil (Default No, Active Yes).
Expected EN: "This Colli Type cannot be deleted because it is already used by one or more Colli codes."
Error card: ETM-15546. Relates ETM-15543 (RE-OPEN). Assignee Faisal Bahari.

recent_failures.title: Delete Colli Type yang belum dipakai — soft delete dan Show deleted already deleted
recent_failures.log_summary:
FAIL copy Show deleted — soft delete unused CT-QA-01 (edit/1) sukses. Toast "The data has been success deleted". Hilang dari list default.
Show deleted ON: CT-QA-01 muncul; kolom Action = link "Deleted" → /supplychain/colli-type/edit/1.
Expected keterangan: already deleted.
Error card: ETM-15547. Relates ETM-15543 (RE-OPEN). Assignee Faisal Bahari.

recent_failures.title: Active OFF ditolak jika Colli Type sudah dipakai Colli code dari New Colli inbound
recent_failures.log_summary:
FAIL — lock “dipakai Colli code” tidak jalan; pesan expected tidak muncul.
Setup: inbound baru IN-5U4F3GSR (edit/130307), Draft, Location Gudang Tanrise FAT DROPOFF, SKU-ILYASTEST, New Colli + type preselect PLT | Pallet → COL-6A7EA8FB. Multisku Colli: COL-6A7EA8FB | IN-5U4F3GSR | PLT | Pallet. Inbound tidak di-Approve.
Attempt 1 (PLT masih Default ON): Active OFF → reject "Default Colli Type cannot be inactive." Bukan pesan used-by-colli.
Attempt 2: BOX di-set Default ON (demote PLT), lalu PLT Active OFF → toast "The data has been success updated". Active jadi OFF padahal COL-6A7EA8FB masih ada.
Expected EN: "This Colli Type cannot be set to Inactive because it is already used by one or more Colli codes. Keep it Active, or create a new Colli Type for future use."
Post-run: Active PLT di-ON-kan lagi supaya TC-008/010/013 masih punya type Active yang dipakai.
